title: {Syn} Quantum Error Correction Protects Fragile Information
content:
Quantum information is fragile because measurement and noise can disturb a state. Quantum error correction encodes logical qubits across multiple physical qubits.

The surprising part is that errors can be diagnosed indirectly without copying an unknown quantum state, which would violate the no-cloning theorem.

Why it matters: science facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
